targets.old_statement: Twenty-five thousand dollars opens bodily coverage, fifty thousand covers multi-victim crashes, twenty-five thousand covers property, and every figure counts per accident.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Twenty-five thousand dollars opens bodily coverage, fifty thousand covers multi-victim crashes, twenty-five thousand covers property, and every figure counts per accident.
targets.statement: On the compulsory insurance page, Oklahoma's minimum limits are printed as twenty-five thousand dollars for injury or death of two or more persons, fifty thousand dollars for injury or death of two or more persons, and twenty-five thousand dollars of property damage, with all minimum limits counted per accident.

targets.old_statement: Airbags threaten sub-five-foot riders, under-twelves ride aft, and the back seat beats the front by twenty-six percent.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Airbags threaten sub-five-foot riders, under-twelves ride aft, and the back seat beats the front by twenty-six percent.
targets.statement: Airbag force has killed children and older adults under five feet tall; when a vehicle has a passenger-side airbag, the Highway Safety Administration recommends seating children under twelve in back, and even without airbags the back seat is at least twenty-six percent safer than the front.
